definitions.gloss: high image quality; high resolution; high definition
definitions.explanation: A high level of visual quality in a photo, video, display, or camera — sharp, clear, and with fine detail. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier meaning high-quality or high-resolution.

examples.japanese: {高画質|こうがしつ}のカメラ。
このテレビは{高画質|こうがしつ}で{有名|ゆうめい}です。
examples.english: This TV is famous for its high image quality.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}を{高画質|こうがしつ}で{保存|ほぞん}するとファイルが{大|おお}きくなる。
examples.english: When you save videos in high quality, the files become large.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}のスマホは{高画質|こうがしつ}な{写真|しゃしん}が{簡単|かんたん}に{撮|と}れる。
examples.english: Recent smartphones can easily take high-resolution photos.

notes:
Composed of {高|こう} (high) and {画質|がしつ} (image quality). Refers to sharpness, resolution, and fidelity of photos, video, and displays. It is commonly used on product packaging, streaming service settings, and camera specifications.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {高画質|こうがしつ}で{撮|と}る (shoot in high quality)
- As a の-modifier: {高画質|こうがしつ}のテレビ (a high-definition TV)
- Occasionally used as a な-adjective in casual writing: {高画質|こうがしつ}な{映像|えいぞう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高画質|こうがしつ}{動画|どうが}: high-quality video
- {高画質|こうがしつ}{画像|がぞう}: a high-resolution image
- {高画質|こうがしつ}で{配信|はいしん}する: to stream in high definition
- {高画質|こうがしつ}モード: high-quality mode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {低画質|ていがしつ}: low image quality — the direct antonym
- {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}: high resolution — more technical, emphasizes pixel count rather than overall picture quality
- {高精細|こうせいさい}: high definition, fine detail — often used for displays and broadcast video
